business_summary: C-SITE Co., Ltd. engages in the design, production, and export of knitted clothing products in Korea and internationally. It produces knitwear through original equipment manufacturing (OEM) and some original development manufacturing (ODM) methods. The company was founded in 1999 and is based in Seoul, South Korea.
business_summary_ko: 씨사이트(주)는 국내 및 해외 니트의류 제품의 디자인, 생산, 수출을 담당하고 있습니다. OEM(Original Equipment Manufacturing)과 일부 ODM(Original Development Manufacturing) 방식을 통해 니트웨어를 생산합니다. 이 회사는 1999년에 설립되었으며 대한민국 서울에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
